data.title: Deepfake Anomalies in Video KYC Session
data.description: Detects anomalies during video KYC (Know Your Customer) sessions that may indicate the use of deepfake technology. Indicators include irregular frame rates suggesting real-time face-swapping, inconsistent lighting between face and background, lip-sync desynchronization, unnatural eye-blink patterns, and face-boundary artifacts.

detection.condition: selection and (filter_frame_anomaly or filter_lipsync or filter_blink or filter_lighting)

falsepositives: Poor internet connection causing frame drops and variable frame rates
Unusual ambient lighting conditions in the caller's environment
Customer wearing heavy makeup or glasses affecting facial analysis
